{{Top|leg}}
A '''guidance buoy''' was a buoy used to guide [[Starship/Legends|starships]] into [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]. In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Bilbringi Shipyards]] used a guidance buoy to escort the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Etherway|Garret's Gold]]'' through Bilbringi Shipyards.
